Definition
[Domain of discontinuity and Kleinian group] \group Kleinian groupsSource: thurston:page-0189 Set $D_\Gamma =S^{n-1}_\infty \setminus L_\Gamma $. A discrete subgroup of $\PSL (2,\C )$ with $D_\Gamma \neq \varnothing $ is called a Kleinian group.
